title: RS-MTDF: Multi-Teacher Distillation and Fusion for Remote Sensing Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: During SSL, frozen VFMs (DINOv2, CLIP) act as feature teachers. Student encoder features are aligned to theirs, and the distilled features are fused into the student decoder to bridge the labelled/unlabelled distribution gap.
adaptation: Use DINOv2-L only, since CLIP has no meaning for EL. Add a feature-alignment loss on train and pool cells to the house R34 encoder, in supervised or SSL training. A cheaper, single-stage sibling of GKD.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + DINOv2-L feature alignment loss on pool cells, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, inactive IoU, clean-49 crack IoU. Kill: no metric beyond noise.
evidence: R: SOTA or comparable on ISPRS Potsdam, LoveDA and DeepGlobe across label ratios, with the highest IoU in most LoveDA classes.
prior_overlap: Partial. Same open slot as GKD (pool objective other than MIM/DDeP).
